sky_atmosphere.purpose: Optional independently painted atmosphere; never fused into terrain.

foundation.purpose: Stable terrain, ponds, path, far mountains, and distant spruces; no customizable objects.

edge_coverings.purpose: Fixed edge masks that hide object seams without obscuring the object identity.

placement_rule: Hero x/y are centre-bottom anchors. Replace only one hero file at a time, preserve the slot's target w/h and z, and leave the fixed coverings above it.
